instruction: At the bottom of www.gla.ac.uk, there's the postal code of the university. But I suspect this postal code isn't actually located at the university. Please help me search and locate this postal code using the system's built-in Map app.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get value of attribute "AXTitle" of window 1 of (first application process whose frontmost is true)' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Hillhead" && osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get value of attribute "AXTitle" of window 1 of (first application process whose frontmost is true)' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Glasgow" && echo "True" || echo "False"
